metadata.name: AO LIONHEART — synthetic training scenario
metadata.disclaimer: All tactical graphics, unit positions, NAIs, sensor placements, and labels are FICTIONAL. Geography (terrain, drainage envelope, road corridor, settlement nodes) is real Hamrin range, Iraq. Do not interpret as actual intelligence.
metadata.anchor: Hamrin range, Diyala / Salah ad-Din border, northern Iraq
